Whether successive NYSPSC rate cases (CECONY Jan2026-Dec2028, O&R Jan2025-Dec2027) capture enough allowed-ROE + rate-base growth to outrun the sharply higher embedded cost of debt (CP yield 0.3%->5.6% 2021-23; new coupons 3.1-4.0% -> 5.2-6.15%) while funding ~$4.8B/yr utility capex — the single lever the regulated-earnings engine hinges on.
